name: Legal Mango's Shop
source:
As a new worker of the one and only popular shop in town, your daily life starts to drift differently.. What will happen? What's waiting for you? Play to find out!

[From [url=https://mangopp.itch.io/legal-mangos-shop]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
作为镇上唯一一家人气店铺的新进店员，你的日常生活开始悄然偏离原有的轨道……接下来会发生什么？又有什么在前方等待着你？亲自游玩一探究竟吧！

[摘自[url=https://mangopp.itch.io/legal-mangos-shop]itch.io[/url]]
